ddl.name: level_runs_status_ck
ddl.value: [level_runs].[status] in (N'active', N'paused', N'review', N'passed', N'extended', N'failed', N'stopped', N'promoted')

ddl.name: run_tasks_status_ck
ddl.value: [run_tasks].[status] in (N'todo', N'doing', N'help', N'na', N'done', N'void')

ddl.name: signoffs_one_of
ddl.value: ([signoffs].[stage_key] is not null and [signoffs].[review_id] is null) or ([signoffs].[stage_key] is null and [signoffs].[review_id] is not null)

ddl.name: user_scopes_one_of
ddl.value: ([user_scopes].[store_id] is not null and [user_scopes].[area_id] is null) or ([user_scopes].[store_id] is null and [user_scopes].[area_id] is not null)

ddl.name: versions_effective_ck
ddl.value: [versions].[effective_to] is null or [versions].[effective_from] is null or [versions].[effective_to] >= [versions].[effective_from]
